oracle_semantics: Complete closed physical L/R/T bags with row identity, SQL TRUE selected triplets and NOT TRUE complement across the full product. WHERE is applied before downstream GROUP; SQL NULL never satisfies ordinary equals. The emitted count is the multiplicity of surviving identity triplets.
proof_policy: No mandatory cell may be downgraded to a residual; an unproved cell blocks TASK-115 Done. Direct, dbt and ODCS source facts must represent the same physical facts. Parser and runtime claims remain separately classified.
